bugs.cause: viewport-layout reparents clan-status into a footer; insertBefore used the former direct-child relationship
bugs.fix: Place navigation in its actual toolbar, or before the owned content before layout. Close clan windows on successful leave/disband before refresh.

bugs.cause: Clan chat stopped input on HTTP 403 but never refreshed membership or closed the clan window
bugs.fix: Close clan portals and reload membership when access is revoked.

bugs.cause: Absolutely positioned greeting overlapped the Ether generator; pointer hit the greeting instead of the button
bugs.fix: Keep greeting in document flow after the generator; only its dismiss button takes pointer input.

stone.viewport: Only the existing 40 px drift padding is requested; the full diagonal rotation envelope is no longer needed.

windowsFull.note: Three obsolete spin assertions ran while the owner changed the requirement; updated stone/poison suite subsequently passed 13/13. Original failures retained.

linuxFull.candidate: V1 indexed effect lookup, no specialized root fast path; final UI and revised no-spin tests
linuxFull.skips: Four tests requiring an explicit isolated real PostgreSQL configuration. Production PG was observed healthy but is not used by this suite.

initialFailures: Baseline clan leave reproduced insertBefore (caught in UI), closing timed out.
First three-browser run assumed the underlying ranking dialog was closed; fixed the harness navigation.
Kick fixture initially lacked clanId; next run was covered by an unclaimed daily reward. Both setup failures retained.
With correct fixture home kick closes; chat kick still timed out. Fixed chat revoke.
Existing smoke test reproduced Effi intercepting the generator click.
First isolated Linux benchmark lacked booster assets; second lacked accessory config. Neither is a valid performance result.
